correctness.rationale: Use globally smooth first integral H=xw-y²/2 in piecewise coordinates, with negative-energy seam always transverse. Verify smooth cylindrical leaves and zero seam-normal flux jump. Surface divergence -|x|<0 almost everywhere excludes discs and annuli bounded by periodic cycles. Primary 2023 Theorem 1 supplies existence for q1. Exact saltation determinants one and Liouville determinant give strict transverse contraction, energy scaling and inversion give rigidity. Poincaré–Bendixson is applied only to bounded forward orbit on two-dimensional cylinder, with seam-crossing local flowboxes. Embedded symbolic checker executed from actual files supports local identities but cannot substitute for global proof.
